title: My Friends and Their Jobs
text:
My friend Anna is a doctor. She works at a big hospital in the city. She helps sick people every day.

My brother Tom is a teacher. He works at a school. He likes his students very much.

questions.text: What kind of person is Anna probably?
How does Tom probably feel about his job?
options: He is always tired of it

vocabulary.definition: a person who helps sick people
a place where doctors help sick people
people who learn at a school

paragraph_translations: Moja przyjaciółka Anna jest lekarką. Pracuje w dużym szpitalu w mieście. Codziennie pomaga chorym ludziom.
Mój brat Tom jest nauczycielem. Pracuje w szkole. Bardzo lubi swoich uczniów.
